Previously spent400-cell CD4 condition, now development only
contexts.selected_by: Alphabetical target names, counts>=400, matched-control batch support only; one seed and eight targets maximum

null_policy.scope: One frozen400-cell null case per context with actual controls excluded from inference controls and disjoint400-cell NTC reference; null pool combines the old left/right controls before a new three-way split. Conditional must satisfy mean contract and real-control DE/detection/variance envelope in every context. Unlike old identity gates, returning V24 alone is not sufficient. This new protocol does not change old failed experiments.

hypothesis: On the spent H1 control case, global integer repair plus CPM swaps without depth strata meets all null envelopes (2 calls, CPM L1 1.196e-6), whereas adding depth strata creates239 calls. Test removal prospectively across all context nulls and historical treatment cases. This is a separate frozen follow-up, not a revision or rescue selection inside V27.
selection: The raw control-anchored global transport is the SOLE eligible finalist, chosen from sampler/control evidence before any V28 treatment score. Neural and quantile arms are H1 diagnostics, cannot replace it after outcomes. V27 comparisons continue unchanged; no V27 outcome informs V28 selection.
execution: All3 null splits in H1,HCT116,HEK293T and both CD4 states must pass before ANY V28 treatment is scored. H1 includes7 matched arms with immutable masked/panel pretrained models excluding H1. Other families have only V24/global-anchor, requiring no new neural fits or neural source features. After nulls pass, all44 historical treatment cases. Intermediate family treatment checks protect raw guard limits; final global/context-balanced assessment requires >=3 primary improvements including DE, improved centered shape, exact means and worst-family guards.
release: After full development passes, lock sole finalist, complete author-MD5-verified D3Rest raw reserve and exclude ALL CD4 response evidence. Same available raw guards and audits, no adaptive substitution. Official packaging/full-payload/provenance/replay verification required. No automatic upload.
limitations: Development biology reused, null seeds reuse cells across splits; fitting/templates/actual/reference are cell-disjoint but not asserted guide/batch-disjoint. HCT116 NMAE unavailable; CD4D1 treatment counts200. Anchor transports generic NTC variation and preserves V24 means, not a claim of identified target-specific stochastic dynamics. The pretrained neural response basis used allowed source summaries including source validation cells; source checkpoint ELBO is not a wholly independent preprocessing validation. Entire evaluation family still excluded from neural/mean fits.
